projectDescription: Self-hostable AI incident-investigation platform that monitors Slack, Sentry, Datadog, and other observability tools to automatically investigate production alerts, produce structured reports, and propose code remediations.
keyFeatures: Automatic incident investigation triggered by Sentry issues, Datadog monitors, Dash0 alerts, and Slack channel messages
AI-powered structured investigation reports with severity classification (SEV-1/2/3), root cause analysis, timeline, and evidence
Automated code remediation with pull request generation against connected GitHub repositories
Deep integration context from Slack, Sentry, Datadog, Dash0, PostHog, Grafana, Axiom, Upstash, Langfuse, Supabase, Vercel, AWS, Google Cloud, ClickStack, and custom MCP servers
Linear ticket creation from investigation issues with customizable Markdown templates
Workspace secrets vault for injecting API credentials into investigation sandboxes
Versioned immutable agent configurations with pinned runtime profiles for reproducible reruns
Multi-workspace, multi-tenant architecture with encrypted per-organization credential storage
Automations for running recurring or event-driven investigation workflows
Slack thread mode for ad-hoc investigations directly from a Slack conversation
publicApiSurface: GET /api/agents/options — list agent configuration options (channels, repos, etc.)
GET /api/agents/thread-mode — get Slack thread mode configuration
PUT /api/agents/thread-mode — save Slack thread mode configuration
AgentConfiguration schema (trigger, reporting, model, instructions, prMode, contextAccountIds, repositoryIds, secretIds)
Agent triggers: sentry_issue, datadog_monitor, dash0_alert, slack_channel, slack_mention
Agent reporting modes: thread, output_channel, both
Investigation report schema (headline, summary, issues with SEV-1/2/3 severity, evidence, timeline, remediations)
Remediation types: code_change (with git diff + PR content), external_action (human-readable prompt)
